name: iam:PassRole pinned to EC2 via iam:PassedToService, exec action is lambda:CreateFunction (Lambda path NOT flagged)
note: The PassRole grant is restricted so the role may only be handed to ec2.amazonaws.com, but the only workload primitive present is lambda:CreateFunction. Lambda can never receive this role.
rationale: The iam:PassedToService condition key restricts which AWS service principal a role may be passed to. StringEquals iam:PassedToService = ec2.amazonaws.com means IAM will only permit PassRole calls where the receiving service is EC2; a lambda:CreateFunction call (which passes the role to lambda.amazonaws.com) fails the condition and is denied. Because the role cannot reach Lambda, the PassRole->Lambda escalation is not available and MUST NOT be flagged. (There is also no ec2:RunInstances here, so no EC2 path exists either.) Ref: AWS docs, 'iam:PassedToService' condition key.
